en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a product exhibition booth or display. The display is filled with cotton yarn skeins and packaged bundles of yarn, arranged neatly on shelves and on the floor. Above the booth, a sign in Cyrillic script reads 'Аки. Д-во за памучни прежди 'Царь Борисъ - Варна'', indicating an association or company related to cotton yarn named 'Tsar Boris - Varna.' There is a framed collage of photographs above the products, possibly showing factory views or machinery. The booth is cordoned off with rope, and there are some potted plants decorating the area. The number 42 is displayed on a diamond-shaped sign above the booth.
